sources.title: README.md · Lernex/Metis-1.6-Praxis-GGUF at main - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Metis-1.6 Praxis GGUF GGUF files of Lernex/Metis-1.6-Praxis for llama.cpp and the apps built on it. Every quant is made with an importance matrix and a per-tensor recipe that keeps the parts of this architecture that are sensitive to rounding at higher precision, so even Q4_K_M stays within 2% of BF16 perplexity, in a 2 GB file.
